notes: Child-specific notices (slice 2). Every call begins with the listener check, which names the child and nothing else; everything specific is said only after the parent presses 1.
A1, A3 and A4 share ONE wording on purpose: a parent cannot tell which of them triggered the call, and none states a concern. The reason lives only in the approver's evidence.
Fee scripts never threaten, never mention a consequence, never ask for a number or a payment on the call, and always carry the OTP warning.

attendance_talk.listenerCheck: Namaste. This is a recorded message from {schoolName} for the parent of {childName}. If you are {childName}'s parent or guardian, please press 1.
attendance_talk.message: Thank you. {childName}'s class teacher would like to speak with you this week about how {childName} is doing at school.
attendance_talk.menu: If you would like the school to call you to fix a time, press 1. If you'd rather not get these calls, press 9.
attendance_talk.confirm_1: Thank you. We've let the class teacher know, and the school will call you to fix a time.
